slides.narration: Chapter 26: The Infinite Tower. The tower does not stop at any finite stage. It continues forever — each stage more screened than the last — and its total content converges to a finite value: one over pi.

lines: Infinite in stages, finite in content
slides.narration: The infinite tower is the journey from Omega back to Omega — infinite in stages but finite in content. And the cosmological constant — the energy of empty space, which physicists call the worst prediction in history — dissolves into 212 ordinary screenings, each dimming by about a quarter.
